title: Session expires while protected speech is being released
description: The session expires or is revoked between the gateway issuing a SpeechPlan and the audio release guard emitting it; the emission-time re-check must stop the protected utterance.
callerVisible: The protected sentence stops at the boundary; the caller hears the approved re-verification notice or a connecting prompt.
backendEvidence: Audio release receipt with a refused emission and the session generation it was checked against
No playback status for the protected segment after expiry
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:AUTH_EXPIRY_DURING_SPEECH] owned by WP-14 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: emission-time session re-check at the audio release boundary

postconditions: The emission-time session re-check refuses every protected segment queued before the expiry
The release receipt records the refusal with the session generation; no protected audio reaches the caller
The fallback notice is a pre-approved non-protected utterance
